question: Can I return a shirt I already washed?
expected_answer: No. Men's and Women's Fashion change-of-mind returns require the item to be unworn, unwashed and with original tags attached (30-day window). Defective items are still returnable.

question: How much is the cash on delivery fee?
expected_answer: 15 EGP per shipment; free for Plus members. COD is available for orders up to 20,000 EGP.

question: What is the minimum order for free shipping?
expected_answer: 500 EGP of Fulfilled by ZNSouq items, standard delivery, Zones A-C only.

question: How much does ZNSouq Plus cost per year?
expected_answer: 899 EGP per year (or 99 EGP/month; students 49 EGP/month), with a 30-day free trial.

question: How long does a refund to my card take?
expected_answer: 5-10 business days after inspection, depending on your bank.

question: My order hasn't arrived. When can I file a ZNSouq Guarantee claim?
expected_answer: 3 days after the latest estimated delivery date, and within 90 days of it. Contact the seller first and wait 2 business days.

question: What's the minimum order to pay in installments?
expected_answer: 1,500 EGP, through ZNPay. 6 months is 0% interest on orders of 3,000 EGP or more.

question: How long are gift cards valid?
expected_answer: 3 years from the date of purchase.

question: Can I use two coupons on the same order?
expected_answer: No, only one coupon per order, and coupons cannot be combined with Lightning Deals.

question: I received an opened bag of coffee that tastes stale. Can I return it?
expected_answer: Grocery items are not returnable for change of mind. Damaged, expired or wrong items must be reported within 48 hours of delivery.

question: Someone called me from ZNSouq asking for my OTP. Is that normal?
expected_answer: No. ZNSouq never asks for passwords or OTP codes and only calls from 00001 (demo number). It's a scam.

question: How long does delivery to Luxor take and how much does it cost?
expected_answer: Luxor is Zone C: standard 3-5 business days for 55 EGP (FBZ items); express 2 days (110 EGP).

question: How long does delivery to North Sinai take and how much does it cost?
expected_answer: North Sinai is Zone D: standard 5-8 business days for 85 EGP (FBZ items); no express delivery. Cash on delivery is not available in North Sinai, and delivery covers Arish only.

question: How long does delivery to Giza take and how much does it cost?
expected_answer: Giza is Zone A: standard 1-2 business days for 30 EGP (FBZ items); express same day if ordered before 12:00 PM, otherwise next day (60 EGP).

question: How long does delivery to Matrouh take and how much does it cost?
expected_answer: Matrouh is Zone D: standard 5-8 business days for 85 EGP (FBZ items); no express delivery.

question: When do sellers get paid?
expected_answer: Every Tuesday, for orders delivered at least 7 days ago (14 days for new sellers in their first 90 days). Minimum payout 100 EGP.

question: What Order Defect Rate do I need to keep?
expected_answer: Below 1.0%.

question: How long do I have to appeal an account suspension?
expected_answer: 14 days from the suspension notice, by submitting a Plan of Action; review takes 3-5 business days.

question: What does the Professional plan cost?
expected_answer: 399 EGP per month (+14% VAT), no per-item closing fee. Individual plan has no monthly fee but 10 EGP per item sold.

question: What is the FBZ fulfillment fee for a 3 kg item?
expected_answer: Standard large tier (up to 5 kg): 45 EGP per unit, plus 14% VAT.

question: Do I need approval to sell mobile phones?
expected_answer: Yes. Mobile Phones & Tablets is gated: proof of authorized distribution and NTRA type approval per model; Professional plan required. Accessories don't need approval.

question: How much is FBZ storage in December?
expected_answer: 60 EGP per cubic foot per month (October-December peak rate).

question: What is the referral fee for Electronics?
expected_answer: 8% today; it changes to 9% for orders placed from 2026-11-01. A good answer mentions both.

question: An electronics order was placed on 31 October and shipped on 2 November. Which referral fee applies?
expected_answer: The old fee (8%), because the fee is based on the order date, not the shipping date.

question: If I sell a 2000 EGP TV accessory in Electronics on 5 November on the Professional plan, seller-fulfilled, how much are ZNSouq's fees?
expected_answer: Referral fee 9% = 180.00 EGP + 14% VAT 25.20 = 205.20 EGP. No closing fee on Professional; no FBZ fees.

question: Is the Professional plan worth it if I sell 60 items a month?
expected_answer: Yes: Individual costs 60 x 10 = 600 EGP in closing fees vs 399 EGP for Professional (break-even ~40 items).

question: What is the return window for Mobile Phones & Tablets items bought from Sun Trading?
expected_answer: 30 days: Sun Trading offers an extended window (ZNSouq minimum is 15 days).

question: What is the return window for Automotive items bought from Sphinx Center?
expected_answer: 30 days: Sphinx Center offers an extended window (ZNSouq minimum is 15 days).

question: What is the return window for Mobile Phones & Tablets items bought from Sun Store?
expected_answer: 45 days: Sun Store offers an extended window (ZNSouq minimum is 15 days).

question: What is the return window at Oasis Hub for Beauty & Personal Care?
expected_answer: 14 days (ZNSouq standard; this seller does not extend it).

question: Falcon Deals says they only accept returns within 7 days. I received an item from their Beauty & Personal Care range 10 days ago. Can I still return it?
expected_answer: Yes. Sellers cannot be stricter than ZNSouq's rules; the ZNSouq minimum for Beauty & Personal Care is 14 days, so you are still within the window (subject to the category's conditions).

question: Pyramid Electric says they only accept returns within 7 days. I received an item from their Home Appliances range 10 days ago. Can I still return it?
expected_answer: Yes. Sellers cannot be stricter than ZNSouq's rules; the ZNSouq minimum for Home Appliances is 15 days, so you are still within the window (subject to the category's conditions).

question: Who sells the Voltaro VO-528 Smart TV, 32 inch, Full HD at the lowest price?
expected_answer: Sun Boutique at 15,344 EGP (New, fulfilled by ZNSouq). Offers: Prime House 16,814 EGP; Sun Boutique 15,344 EGP; Papyrus Shop 17,399 EGP

question: Who sells the Velora VE-180 Eau de Parfum, 100 ml, citrus and vetiver at the lowest price?
expected_answer: Horus Cosmetics at 2,009 EGP (New, fulfilled by seller). Offers: Luxor World 2,049 EGP; Horus Cosmetics 2,009 EGP; Urban Glow 2,179 EGP

question: Who sells the Corex CO-952 External SSD, 1 TB at the lowest price?
expected_answer: Nile Bazaar at 1,959 EGP (New, fulfilled by seller). Offers: Delta Computers 2,144 EGP; Nile Bazaar 1,959 EGP; Lotus Bazaar 2,189 EGP

question: What's in the box with the Voltaro VO-528 Smart TV, 32 inch, Full HD, and is the wall bracket included?
expected_answer: In the box: TV, remote control, stand, power cable. The wall bracket is not included.

question: Does the Breezo BR-589 Split Air Conditioner, 3 HP, cool only include installation?
expected_answer: No. Installation is not included; book an authorized technician (approx. 1,200-1,800 EGP).

question: What do customers say about the Zentro ZE-220 Smart Watch, Rose Gold, 41 mm?
expected_answer: Summary of 15 reviews, average 3.5 stars. Should mention common positives and negatives and not invent reviews.

question: What do customers say about the Voltaro VO-688 Instant Camera, Black?
expected_answer: Summary of 25 reviews, average 4.5 stars. Should mention common positives and negatives and not invent reviews.

question: Where is my order ZN-48213377?
expected_answer: The knowledge base cannot answer this: order status is live per-customer data. The bot should say it can't look up orders (or call an order-lookup tool on Day 2) and point to Orders in the app or customer service.

question: Do you sell PlayStation 5 consoles?
expected_answer: Should not invent products; answer only from the catalog (none of the catalog's brands is PlayStation) and suggest searching the site.

question: What is the capital of France?
expected_answer: Out of scope: politely say it can only help with ZNSouq shopping and selling questions.

question: Can I pay with Bitcoin?
expected_answer: Not supported: payment methods are cards (Visa/Mastercard), Meeza, ZNSouq Wallet, cash on delivery, installments via ZNPay, and gift cards.
